paragraphs: Publisher: {name}. Country: {country}. Launch date: {launched}.

sections.heading: Two different workflows
paragraphs: The TikTok downloader sends a public video link to the server for analysis and preparation. TikTok is the only platform verified for this service. Availability depends on permissions, the source and service limits.
Video to MP3/M4A, compression, trimming and GIF creation process a file you select in your browser. The media file is not uploaded. The browser downloads the processing code from VidFetch.

sections.heading: Boundaries
paragraphs: No YouTube service, watermark removal or bypass of creator download restrictions is offered. A public post does not automatically grant permission to save or redistribute it.

The local tools do not offer cropping, audio normalisation, synchronisation repair or metadata removal. Format and memory support vary by browser. Contact, privacy, terms, copyright and editorial information are linked below when published.

sections.heading: Public links and local files
paragraphs: For a TikTok download, the public link and selected format reach the server and the source platform. They are used to analyse and deliver that requested video, subject to access checks.
Files selected in the local MP3/M4A, compressor, trimmer and GIF tools remain on your device. Engine files are fetched from VidFetch; the selected recording is not sent to a conversion server.

sections.heading: Security cookies and identifiers
paragraphs: No VidFetch user account or public profile is required. Download authorisation uses a Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie, __Host-vidfetch-access, with a 30-minute lifetime. The single-transfer cookie expires with its short-lived ticket. These are access controls, not advertising cookies.

The server receives an IP address to route and secure requests. The gateway derives a keyed identifier for rate limits and quotas; its quota database does not store the raw IP, source URL or video title. Browser signing keys and API grants stay in memory.

sections.heading: Application retention
paragraphs: Unused gateway tickets default to 55 seconds; transfer status defaults to 30 minutes, with expired entries removed during cleanup. Quota counters expire at the UTC day boundary and are deleted on the next cleanup. Anti-replay proof records expire after 90 seconds.

The application does not provide a permanent public media library. Temporary processing resources are released when an operation ends, fails or expires. Downloaded files you save remain on your device until you remove them.

sections.heading: Browser storage
paragraphs: A local conversion may write a temporary output into origin-private file storage (OPFS). It is deleted after its download stream finishes or is cancelled, when you discard it, or during later cleanup after an interrupted visit. A downloaded copy is separate from that temporary.

A scoped service worker assists local downloads. Browser caching and site storage may retain the worker and engine assets. You can clear site data in your browser; doing so can interrupt a current local operation.

sections.heading: Infrastructure and verification
paragraphs: Cloudflare delivers the site and processes network requests. The download verification flow uses Cloudflare Turnstile; its widget contacts Cloudflare and the server verifies the challenge token.

The versioned Caddy configuration disables access logging and filters sensitive request fields from operational errors. Infrastructure log retention, including hosting and Cloudflare settings: {infrastructureRetention}. Do not interpret an example retention file as proof of a live setting.

sections.heading: Advertising
paragraphs: The site may display Google AdSense advertisements in the future; they are not active today. No AdSense advertising script or consent message is activated by this change. Before ads are enabled, the notice and consent configuration must reflect the actual data use.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Where the GDPR applies, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability, and object where applicable. Write to {privacy} with enough context to identify the request, without sending unnecessary personal data. You may complain to the competent data protection authority.
Requests concerning a video hosted on TikTok should also be directed to the source platform. Deleting a local file from your device is under your control.

sections.heading: Service limits
paragraphs: TikTok is the only verified platform. YouTube and watermark removal are not offered. Downloads are not guaranteed; source availability, format support, duration and capacity limits apply.

Current gateway defaults limit downloads to 8 operations and 1 GiB per IP/temporary identity per UTC day, with 100 operations and 4 GiB globally. A transfer is capped at 256 MiB and a video at 30 minutes. A busy or exhausted service may refuse a request.

Local tools have separate device-dependent limits, displayed on their pages and checked before processing. Their input limit is not a guarantee of available RAM or output storage. Do not leave the tab during a conversion; check the result before deleting the source.

Un service worker de portée limitée aide au téléchargement local. Le cache et le stockage du navigateur peuvent conserver ce worker et les fichiers du moteur. Effacer les données du site peut interrompre une opération en cours.
